server.instructions: Crow Memory — Ebe nchekwa synaptic mpụga maka ndị ọrụ AI na-ede koodu. Ọ na-echekwa ụdị koodu gị, nghọta gị banyere nsogbu, na mmasị nhazi gị dị ka matrikị arọ a kpakọrọ na crow.bin.

crow_memory_bias.description: Ngalaba nhụsị Crow Memory nke a na-etinye na-akpaghị aka. Ọ nwere ụdị koodu gị, mmasị gị na iwu ndị mepụtara. Onye ọbịa kwesịrị iburu ya na mmalite nnọkọ.

crow_evolved_rules.description: Permanent evolved rules from Crow's system_prompt.md: permanent rules (human-promoted via CROW_ADMIN_TOKEN) plus unreviewed model suggestions.

crow_recall.description: Weghachite ụdị koodu, nghọta banyere nsogbu, mmasị nhazi, ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ onwe onye nke onye ọrụ site na nchekwa synaptic Crow. Kpọọ nke a tupu azịza ọ bụla iji kwekọọ na nhụsị inductive nke onye ọrụ. Na ndabere (register=all ma ọ bụ hapụ ya, domain=all), ọ na-ajụ register 8 niile ma jikọta nsonaazụ ya n'ozuzu dịka myirịta dị irè si dị.

parameters.query: Nkọwa n'asụsụ nkịtị banyere ọrụ dị ugbu a.
parameters.register: Kedu register. Jiri 'all' (ma ọ bụ hapụ ya) iji jụọ register niile dị na ngalaba ahọpụtara. Code: style/bug/arch/context. Life: life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context.
parameters.domain: Nzacha ngalaba a na-eji mgbe register bụ 'all' ma ọ bụ hapụrụ ya. 'code' = style/bug/arch/context, 'life' = life_pref/life_avoid/life_phil/life_context, 'all' = register 8 niile (ndabere).
parameters.format: Ụdị mmepụta. 'hint' na-eweghachi aro JSON (ndabere); 'bias_block' na-eweghachi ngalaba ederede [User Bias] maka itinye na prompt sistemụ.
parameters.project: Mkpado ọrụ a na-eji kwalite aro nke otu ọrụ ahụ na ịzacha ma ọ bụ ịtụ aro nke ọrụ ndị ọzọ ntaramahụhụ.
parameters.strict_project: Mgbe ọ bụ true, ọ na-ewepụ kpamkpam aro nke ọrụ ndị ọzọ na nsonaazụ.

crow_ingest.description: Tinye ahụmịhe koodu n'ime nchekwa synaptic ogologo oge nke Crow. Kpọọ nke a mgbe nsonaazụ build/test ma ọ bụ nzaghachi doro anya nke onye ọrụ gasịrị. Nye polarity doro anya ma ọ bụ exit_code nke build maka nhazi polarity akpaghị aka. A na-ebu ụzọ sachapụ ọdịnaya; a na-ajụ ntinye nke bụ naanị mkpọtụ n'emetughị nchekwa ahụ.

parameters.value: Ụkpụrụ koodu ma ọ bụ mkpebi etinyere.
parameters.polarity: Ike nkwado [-2.0, 2.0]. Ọ dịghị mkpa ma ọ bụrụ na enyere exit_code; polarity doro anya na-emeri mgbe enyere ha abụọ.
parameters.exit_code: Koodu ọpụpụ build (0 = ihe ịga nke ọma). Ọ na-ahazi akpaghị aka gaa polarity (+1.5/+0.5 na ihe ịga nke ọma, -0.5/-1.0 na ọdịda) belụsọ ma enyere polarity doro anya.
parameters.user_edited: Ma onye ọrụ deziri mmepụta AI. Ọ na-edozi polarity sitere na exit_code.
parameters.project: Mkpado ọrụ echekwara na ndekọ ncheta maka ịcheta ọrụ mechara mara.

crow_admin.description: Ọrụ nchịkwa Crow n'otu ngwá ọrụ. Omume: diagnostics (ọnụ ọgụgụ ncheta), drift (nyocha drift), prompt (gụ, tinye, ma ọ bụ nweta ọnụ ọgụgụ system_prompt.md), backup (mepụta, tụgharịa, ndepụta, ma ọ bụ weghachite), evolve (tụpụta mgbanwe prompt), project_info (ndepụta ma ọ bụ mepụta ihe atụ ọrụ).

parameters.action: Kedu ọrụ nchịkwa: diagnostics, drift, prompt, backup, evolve, ma ọ bụ project_info.
parameters.args: Ihe arụmụka akọwapụtara omume a na-enyefe ọrụ ahọpụtara.

errors.project_name_required: A chọrọ project_name maka omume create

recall_messages.faint_bias: Crow na-echeta nhụsị {register} dị ntakịrị. Obere ncheta ka echekwara.

evolve_messages.no_patterns: Ọnwebeghị ụkpụrụ bara uru n'ụzọ ọnụ ọgụgụ achọpụtara.

drift_messages.confused: Ncheta Crow yiri ka ọ gbagwojuru anya. Ọrụ ndị na-adịbeghị anya nwere ike ịbụ ihe ọhụrụ nke ukwuu ma ọ bụ ncheta jupụtara. Tụlee nrụzigharị spectral ma ọ bụ idobe ya n'ebe nchekwa.

system_prompt.subtitle:
> Ndị a bụ iwu Crow mepụtara ma onye ọrụ kwadoro.
> Ha na-anọchite anya nhụsị koodu bara uru n'ụzọ ọnụ ọgụgụ.
> Edela ya n'aka — jiri ngwá ọrụ evolve Crow MCP.
default_rules: RULE: Tupu azịza ọ bụla, kpọọ crow_recall(domain="all") iji jụọ register 8 niile (style, bug, arch, context, life_pref, life_avoid, life_phil, life_context) banyere ụdị koodu, nghọta banyere nsogbu, mmasị nhazi, mmasị onwe onye, nkà ihe ọmụma, na ọnọdụ dị ugbu a nke onye ọrụ. Gosi aro ndị e weghachiri n'azịza gị.

RULE: Mgbe azịza ọ bụla gasịrị, tinye ihe onye ọrụ kpughere — mmasị, nkà ihe ọmụma, mgbazi, ọnọdụ — site na crow_ingest. Kpebie register na polarity kwesịrị ekwesị n'onwe gị n'atụghị anya ka onye ọrụ kwuo "cheta nke a". Mgbe ọrụ koodu gasịrị, tụlee nsonaazụ build akpaghị aka site na crow_ingest_from_build.
RULE: Akwụsịla iwu recall+ingest ọbụlagodi maka ọrụ na-abụghị koodu dịka idezi akwụkwọ, ọrụ git, ma ọ bụ mgbanwe nhazi. Na-arụ ha mgbe niile.
